haikus.haiku:
Crisp sticks flicker bright
Golden curls dance in soft air
Taste sparks joy within
Happy #NationalJulienneFriesDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Laughter drifts like bells
Dancing colors stain the sky
Joy blooms without end
Happy #InternationalYouthDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft candle warm glow
Breeze hums through soft cedar trees
Joy rings bright in sky
#HappyBirthdayWilliamBlake from @ClamBakeSanta

Crescent winks softly
cool silver brushes dark sky
stars hum lullabies
Happy #NewMoon from @ClamBakeSanta

Night sky hums softly
Trails of light dance quick and bright
Warm wishes shoot near
Happy #PerseidMeteorShower from @ClamBakeSanta
